func findHash(n *hashNode,key any,hash uint32,depth uint) *hashPair {
 if n==nil{return nil};if n.bucket!=nil{if n.hash!=hash{return nil};for i:=range n.bucket{if equal(n.bucket[i].key,key){return &n.bucket[i]}};return nil}
 if (hash>>depth)&1==0{return findHash(n.zero,key,hash,depth+1)};return findHash(n.one,key,hash,depth+1)
}
func mergeHash(a,b *hashNode,depth uint) *hashNode{
 x,y:=(a.hash>>depth)&1,(b.hash>>depth)&1;if x!=y{if x==0{return &hashNode{zero:a,one:b}};return &hashNode{zero:b,one:a}}
 child:=mergeHash(a,b,depth+1);if x==0{return &hashNode{zero:child}};return &hashNode{one:child}
}
func insertHash(n *hashNode,pair hashPair,hash uint32,depth uint) *hashNode{
 if n==nil{return &hashNode{hash:hash,bucket:[]hashPair{pair}}}
 if n.bucket!=nil{if n.hash!=hash{return mergeHash(n,&hashNode{hash:hash,bucket:[]hashPair{pair}},depth)};bucket:=append([]hashPair{},n.bucket...);for i,p:=range bucket{if equal(p.key,pair.key){bucket[i]=pair;return &hashNode{hash:hash,bucket:bucket}}};bucket=append(bucket,pair);return &hashNode{hash:hash,bucket:bucket}}

}
func walkHash(n *hashNode,visit func(hashPair)){if n==nil{return};if n.bucket!=nil{for _,p:=range n.bucket{visit(p)};return};walkHash(n.zero,visit);walkHash(n.one,visit)}

func hashMix(hash,value uint32)uint32{return (hash^value)*16777619}

func hashAny(value any)uint32{
 switch x:=value.(type){
 case int64:return uint32(x)^uint32(uint64(x)>>32)
 case uint8:return uint32(x)
 case Char:return uint32(x)
 case bool:if x{return 1};return 0

 case float64:if x==0{x=0};bits:=math.Float64bits(x);data:=make([]byte,8);for i:=0;i<8;i++{data[i]=byte(bits>>(uint(i)*8))};return hashBytes(data)

func binary(name string,a,b any,loc string) any {
 switch name {
 case "==":return equal(a,b)
 case "/=":return !equal(a,b)
 case "&&","||":x,y:=boolean(a,loc),boolean(b,loc);if name=="&&"{return x&&y};return x||y
 case "cons":return append([]any{a},list(b,loc)...)

 case "++":if x,ok:=a.(string);ok{return x+stringValue(b,loc)};fallthrough

 }

 case "%":if y==0{fail(loc,"Division by zero")};r=math.Mod(x,y);case "^":r=math.Pow(x,y)
 case "<":return x<y;case ">":return x>y;case "<=":return x<=y;case ">=":return x>=y
 };if math.IsNaN(r)||math.IsInf(r,0){fail(loc,"Non-finite numeric result")};return r

func intBinary(name string,x,y int64,loc string) any {switch name{
 case "+":return x+y;case "-":return x-y;case "*":return x*y
 case "/":if y==0{fail(loc,"Division by zero")};return x/y
 case "%":if y==0{fail(loc,"Division by zero")};return x%y

 };fail(loc,"Unknown integer operator");return nil}

// Commit a complete stable merge pass, so break preserves a permutation.
type SortItem struct{value,key any}
func stableSort(rows *[]SortItem,less func(any,any)bool) {
 for width:=1;width<len(*rows);width*=2 {
  old:=*rows;next:=make([]SortItem,0,len(old))
  for start:=0;start<len(old);start+=2*width {
   mid:=min(start+width,len(old));end:=min(start+2*width,len(old));i,j:=start,mid
   for i<mid&&j<end {if less(old[j].key,old[i].key){next=append(next,old[j]);j++}else{next=append(next,old[i]);i++}}
   next=append(next,old[i:mid]...);next=append(next,old[j:end]...)
  }
  *rows=next
 }
}

}

func(m *Machine) bitOperation(name string,a,b any,loc string) any {
 logical:=name==".&."||name==".|."||name=="xor"
 if x,ok:=a.(bool);ok&&logical{y:=boolean(b,loc);switch name{case ".&.":return x&&y;case ".|.":return x||y;default:return x!=y}}

 var r int64;switch name{case ".&.":r=x&y;case ".|.":r=x|y;case "xor":r=x^y;case ".<<.":r=x<<uint(y);case ".>>.":r=x>>uint(y);case "testBit":return x&(int64(1)<<uint(y))!=0;case "setBit":r=x|(int64(1)<<uint(y));case "clearBit":r=x&^(int64(1)<<uint(y))}

}

func compareScalar(a,b any)int{
 switch x:=a.(type){
 case int64:y:=b.(int64);if x<y{return -1};if x>y{return 1}
 case uint8:y:=b.(uint8);if x<y{return -1};if x>y{return 1}
 case Char:y:=b.(Char);if x<y{return -1};if x>y{return 1}
 case float64:y:=b.(float64);if x<y{return -1};if x>y{return 1}
 case string:y:=b.(string);if x<y{return -1};if x>y{return 1}
 case bool:y:=b.(bool);if x!=y{if y{return -1};return 1}
